instruction: I prefer not to be tracked while browsing. Please enable the Do Not Track feature in Chrome for me.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling Do Not Track in Chrome privacy settings (chrome://settings/privacy). The evaluator reads the Default/Preferences file to check if 'enable_do_not_track' is set to true. Similar difficulty to original - single privacy setting change.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the 'enable_do_not_track' setting from Chrome's Preferences file
Metric correctly performs boolean comparison of the Do Not Track enabled state
Expected value correctly requires Do Not Track to be enabled (true)
Postconfig properly restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted to disk
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling one setting, evaluator checks that exact setting
Appropriate error handling for missing keys and file read errors
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts right state → metric compares right aspect → expected value is correct
